review.title: Calcium-tomato Paenibacillus: two real source-note and mapping transitions
review.independence_basis: Authored bounded database/source-provenance assessment. Parent independently reviewed the official R226 population evidence, exact note wording, guarded writer, local and M5 note candidates, actual note checkpoint, source config and final mapping candidates. The shared native engine, check runner and review builder were previously independently reviewed. This saved assessment is self-review, not independent whole-record scientific approval.
review.summary: Two actual guarded M5 transitions clarify the Paenibacillus source populations and retain exactly the pinned native descriptor's three alternatives. The note-only intermediate distinguishes the native ncbi_name correspondence with no exact NCBI1406 rows, the verified R226 five-bin name population and the separate six-taxon NCBI correspondence population. The subsequent unchanged status-only engine removes only the unsupported-for-this-native-route D/E alternatives. Neither transition selects a study-stock GTDB species; every other biological claim, neighboring descriptor and old history entry is preserved.
review.scope_description: CommunityMech:000393 taxonomy[2].taxon_term.notes and its complete native GTDB candidate set, the two actual application chains, primary-source identity boundary and current scoped native checks. No whole-record scientific reassessment is claimed.
review.selection: One whole record, the first exact-note then unchanged-mapping canary for the source-held group. The note-only intermediate is preserved in real ROOT commit53007c13842a0fa9785916e6e17b9ff2228407ac; its execution remains ce4c9361ab22a5af0893f61feedb66d81b3a166e. limitations: Partial technical/source-provenance assessment with scientific_review:false. No whole-record scientific approval, corpus QC pass, automatic issue closure or release clearance follows from this bundle.

The native crosswalk release is not established. Its three alternatives derive from ncbi_name with no exact NCBI1406 rows; NCBITaxon:1406 is the requested descriptor, not proof of an exact-ID crosswalk match.

Verified R226 name query193 genomes/five bins and NCBI correspondence128 genomes/six taxa are distinct populations. Neither is substituted as the native candidate list or as the experimental stock's genome identity. The original five-candidate population's release remains unestablished.

The primary article reports Paenibacillus polymyxa raw-read accession SRR33221449. No inspected assembly-grounded GTDB assignment for that study stock is asserted. No species choice, candidate probability, denominator or stock alias is invented.

Source-population judgments rely on the exact retained official-source extraction and additive verification artifacts. This assessment did not reacquire those sources or rerun their original capture helpers. The earlier workbook capture race and its separate successful retained-byte verification remain transparently recorded under2870.

The first transition's eight checks establish the preserved note-only intermediate and are summarized in its bound checkpoint. They are not relabeled as checks of final bytes. The eight required checks below are actual commands against the final mapping bytes, including one new native history sidecar.

Local and M5 NCBI file-stat observations are separately retained. Neither a whole-database checksum nor its release is certified. Exact source/crosswalk/native-code and assessment inputs are hash-bound.

Existing calcium, exudate, microbial interaction, plant response, assay and curated neighboring-taxon claims are preserved, not newly scientifically certified. Prior historical decisions and issues2450/1268 are not cleared by this scoped diagnostic.

Reference-snippet validation, generated pages, the actual strict composite historical admission and final combined full QC are separately accounted work. This bundle preserves both transition inputs for that subsequent proof; it does not claim the not-yet-run integration passed.
